wanted_details.heading: Sanctions-designation details
wanted_details.status: Designated by OFAC on November 4, 2025 under Executive Orders 13694 as amended and 13810, program tags CYBER4 and DPRK4
wanted_details.caution: Jang Kuk Chol (Jang) and Ho Jong Son are North Korean bankers who have helped manage funds, including $5.3 million in cryptocurrency, on behalf of OFAC-designated First Credit Bank. A portion of these funds can be linked to a DPRK ransomware actor that has previously targeted U.S. victims and handled revenue from DPRK IT workers.

sources.title: Recent Actions, November 4, 2025: North Korea and Cyber-related Designations (bankers, Korea Mangyongdae Computer Technology Corporation, Ryujong Credit Bank)

sources.title: Treasury Sanctions DPRK Bankers and Institutions Involved in Laundering Cybercrime Proceeds and IT Worker Funds
美 “자금세탁 北 개인·기관 신규 제재” (United States sanctions further DPRK individuals and entities over money laundering)

disclaimer: Jang Kuk Chol is profiled here as one of two North Korean bankers the Treasury says managed $5.3 million in cryptocurrency for First Credit Bank, part of it traceable to a ransomware actor that also handled DPRK IT workers' revenue.
OFAC prints no Hangul for this name and the entry carries no photograph, so no Korean rendering is published rather than a reconstructed one.

The confidence level of 'confirmed' reflects that this individual is named on OFAC's Specially Designated Nationals list; a sanctions designation is an administrative action by the Treasury and not a criminal charge, and nothing here states that any court has found anything.
